character: Compact, technical Spanish circuit with a mix of tight, slow corners and a long main straight. Five right-handers and eight left-handers demand a well-balanced car with strong low-speed traction.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: heavy-braking corner off the main straight
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into the following technical section

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.technique: Patient trail brake, precise low-speed placement
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running wide on exit

corners.name: Turn 9
corners.type: tight hairpin in the technical middle sector
corners.technique: Hard braking, late apex, progressive throttle on exit
corners.trap: Early throttle causing wheelspin on the tightening exit

corners.name: Turn 12
corners.type: final corner onto the main straight
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the longest straight on the lap
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
